description: Distribution d'eau potable Flandre is a dataset listed in data.gov.be, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by AquaFlanders. Water distribution in Flanders by municipality or part thereof, by the various water distribution companies. Coverage: AquaFlanders. The portal shows the English title as "Drinking water distribution Flanders" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is AquaFlanders. Its keywords include DRINKWATERMAATSCHAPPIJ, SAMENWERKING VLAAMS WATER, DRINKWATERBEDELINGSMAATSCHAPPIJ, AQUAFLANDERS, DRWABE, DRINKWATERBEDELING VLAANDEREN. The listing shows 2012-12-03 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-be.
